title.narrative: Support for Emergency Resilient Agriculture for Food Security Project (PARSA) in Haiti

description.narrative: The project aims to support access to nutritious food and increase climate- and nutrition-smart agricultural production, including in earthquake-affected areas. UNOPS will support the Haiti Ministry of Agriculture, Natural Resources and Rural Development with the rehabilitation and reconstruction of secondary and tertiary rural roads, as well as, thorugh technical supervision services.
